summary.text: Yes. You can use MediSave for outpatient treatment of chronic diseases on the covered list.

details.heading: Covered chronic diseases
details.body: MediSave can be used for outpatient treatment of chronic diseases listed under the Chronic Disease Management Programme.

details.heading: The list is reviewed
details.body: The Ministry of Health regularly reviews which conditions are covered.

example_phrasings: Can I use my MediSave to pay for outpatient treatment of chronic diseases?
Can MediSave pay for chronic disease treatment?
Does MediSave cover outpatient care for chronic diseases?

sources.page_title: Can I use my MediSave to pay for outpatient treatment of chronic diseases?

quotes.text: You can use MediSave for outpatient treatments of the chronic diseases listed below.
The Ministry of Health (MOH) regularly reviews the list of conditions covered under the Chronic Disease Management Programme, to ensure that they continue to meet the needs of Singaporeans.
